scope: Focused scoping review; not systematic review or proof of novelty

sources.title: Using Goal Modeling to Capture Competency Questions in Ontology-based Systems
sources.verification: 期刊作者年份及作者版正文；作者版有占位页眉，不用于卷页元数据

sources.overlap: 直接覆盖业务目标→CQ→概念链。
sources.not_novel: 业务目标驱动本体或目标-CQ关联不能作为首次贡献。
sources.gap: 可研究 LLM 在证据逐步到达下如何控制候选模型的准入与撤回。

sources.title: The NeOn Methodology framework: A scenario-based methodology for ontology development

sources.not_novel: 多阶段工程工作流不是新的。

sources.title: LLMs4OL: Large Language Models for Ontology Learning

sources.title: OntoChat: a Framework for Conversational Ontology Engineering using Language Models

sources.title: Ontology Generation using Large Language Models

sources.title: Enhancing Ontology Engineering with Large Language Models: A Stage-Wise Human-in-the-Loop Study
sources.contribution: 医疗标准文本三个检查点的人机协同对照：术语、类层次、关系；人工输入改善后续阶段匹配指标。
